title: Desert of lost paths
paragraphs: “Curses and sacrifices, huh? It’s a harsh world, isn’t it?”
“It feels kind of Japanese. Based on what I’ve read online, would it be something like a pipe fox?”
“Ah… now that you mention it. From what I know, pipe foxes are said to resemble weasels more than foxes. Rifana’s species must be one that possesses such abilities.”
“Retaining a strong sense of self even after death…”
Big sister’s friend tilted her head toward big sister. Big sister, in turn, tilted her head as well.
“So, Naofumi-sama. What’s the plan for today?”
“About that… I need to discuss it with everyone.”

Father gathered the villagers and explained the plan to investigate the Prado Desert. Of course, it seemed a bit challenging, but the villagers expressed their interest in participating, finding it an exciting endeavor. However, considering the village’s restoration and other issues, everyone discussed the matter thoroughly.

It was decided Big Sister, her friend, and big sister’s older sister, who had high levels, would go as representatives. Among the Filolials, Yuki would lead, with Kou, Sakura, and Kuro also participating. Luna seemed happy just to have Keel by her side.
“If something happens, you’ll come back immediately, right, big brother?”
“Yeah. Since we can return with the portal, we’re planning to stay at the village when possible.”
“The Desert of lost paths… The real issue is figuring out how to navigate through it.”
“If it’s a magical problem, leave it to Gaelion.”
It seems Rival also decided to join the expedition.
“Heroes, may I assist in discovering unknown monsters as well?”

Is the doctor coming too? It feels like a pretty large group. Well, since Assistant didn’t become a companion due to Rival’s decision, having the doctor help out is a fair exchange. With her analytical skills, she might uncover some useful hints.
“Well, if we encounter any issues, we can send a more detailed investigation team later. If we need more manpower, we’ll call for it.”
“Alright! I’m looking forward to it, big brother!”
“Exactly. For now, let’s take it easy. This isn’t about grinding levels… it’s an adventure focused on exploration.”
We all nodded in agreement.
“Then, we’ll depart as soon as preparations are complete!”

And so, we set off toward the Prado Desert. After that, we entered the Desert of lost paths by carriage, heading for the Prado Desert. Thanks to our high levels, it wasn’t too bad, but the desert’s unique terrain made traveling difficult. It’s hot during the day and freezing at night, making it quite a harsh environment. Based on what Father and some villagers who lived near the desert had told us, we decided to limit our travel to nighttime. The heat during the day was just too much. And so, we conducted our investigation at night.
“Is that the thing that looks faintly red?”
From atop a sand dune, we squinted and spotted a ruin-like structure faintly glowing red. Reaching that place was our objective this time.
“It certainly resembles the outlines of the Dracia Mountain Range when it’s active.”
“According to what the Queen said, there’s also a theory that it might be a mirage.”
“A mirage… at night?”
“That’s the thing… but since this is another world where magic exists, there’s a legend that says it could be an illusion created by the remnants of a destroyed nation’s inventions.”
“Trying to explain it scientifically would be pointless, huh?”
“Exactly.”
“Either way, there’s something romantic about going to uncover its true identity.”

To be honest, I’m interested too. Back when this was still a game… it felt like a twisted space-time kind of setting. It was the type of event where you defeated a certain number of monsters and reported to an NPC to gain experience points.
“The desert looks a lot bigger than I thought on the map. I can see the destination, but whether we can get there or not…”
“Indeed.”
“Well, let’s give it a try and see.”

And so, we all began to move forward. Traveling through the desert at night with the Filolials… somehow, it feels like an Arabian adventure, doesn’t it? The Filolials unique to this region, which we saw in the towns and villages we stopped by for information during the day, were beautiful. They seemed built to run on the sand, with a distinct leg shape adapted for the terrain.
“Na~no!”
“Naofumi-chan, Naofumi-chan! We found these clothes being sold in the previous town, so Gaelion-chan and I bought them!”

Rival and big sister’s older sister were wearing what looked like midriff-baring ethnic outfits. It gave off a very Arabian vibe… but I can’t really tell much of a difference with big sister’s older sister. Was it called belly dancing or something like that? The flowing fabric left quite an impression.
“Ufufu! How do I look, Naofumi?”
Her blatant attitude irritates me, but then Sakura steps forward to block her. Go, Sakura! You’ve got this!
“What’s with you? Don’t get in my way, Sakura.”
“Hmm!”
“Na~no!”
As sparks flew between them, big sister and her friend watched with exasperated expressions.
“By the way, I had Rifana and the others change into them too! How do they look?”
Big sister was also wearing something similar to what Rival and the others had on. Her friend, still in her weasel form, was wearing a turban on her head for some reason. She stood out quite a bit.
“How do we look?”
“Uh… well, it looks good on you.”
“Ehehe, thank you.”
“…Yeah.”
Her friend was delighted to be praised, but big sister looked embarrassed. Well, the outfit does show a lot of skin.
“Come on, Sakura, you should put one on too. I bought enough for everyone!”
“Well… I think it would suit Sakura. She could probably pull off a sword dance with dual blades.”
“Naofumi, do you want Sakura to wear it?”
“If it’s for the sake of my eyes, sure.”
“Okay, I’ll go change! I won’t lose to Gaelion. Rifana, Raphtalia, help me!”
“Okay! Can I pet Gaelion?”
“No, you can’t!”
“Ah, I want Kou to pet me instead!”
“That’s right! You can just stick to petting the Filolials!”

Hahaha! Rival, it would be better if big sister’s friend just seduced you already. Father’s innocence—both in body and heart—must never be handed over. Before that happens, big sister’s friend should just corrupt him first!
“Big sister’s friend! Hurry up and take down Rival!”
“What kind of order is that? And… well, I get that we’re dressing for the desert, but it feels like we’re just playing around…”
“That’s right! We’re not here to play!”
“We’re not playing either! We came here to become the rulers of the desert, the Sandwalkers!”
“No, that’s not right. You’re using the wrong term.”
Ren and Kuro were doing their usual comedy routine. Should I be laughing at this? If I act carelessly, Father will probably get mad again, so I’ll just let it slide.
“But seriously… Ren and Kuro, are you guys okay? It’s cold now because it’s night, but during the day… I guess it’s fine since we can portal back if needed.”
Kuro and Ren both prefer wearing dark colors. In the desert, wearing black will just absorb heat and make things hotter.
“N-no problem! R-right, Kuro?”
“No matter the situation, if you calm your mind, even fire will feel cool. Heat means nothing to Kuro!”
Kuro struck a pose that he had clearly practiced with Ren, showing it off to us. To think Kuro knows a phrase like “calm your mind and the fire will feel cool.” Ren must have taught him that.
“Well, if that’s fine with you, I won’t stop you.”
And so, with this carefree conversation, we continued moving through the desert. Since we weren’t used to it, the sand kept dragging at our feet, making things troublesome.
“Hmm… no matter how far we go, it feels like we’re not making any progress. Even with the desert gear the Filolials have on, it’s still tough to move forward.”
Father was using the map to give instructions. I was looking at the desert gear fitted on Yuki and the others. Hmm, with this, traveling through the sand should be much easier. However…
“It feels like we’re getting closer… but also like it’s getting further away. It’s a strange feeling.”
